title: What is the overall rating of the football player Gabriel Tamas in year 201

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT pa.XCL_132
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND pa.XCL_131 LIKE '2011%'
